notes: The FORMAT of a graph template, not a working graph: export the real one from ComfyUI (Save (API Format)) and put placeholders where Foreman fills values. A string that is exactly one placeholder takes the value's type ({{seed}} becomes a number). Foreman fills prompt, seed, width, height and image_1..image_4 (the uploaded stills) for stills; num_frames, fps, seconds and audio_1 for shots.
license: set this to the license of every model the graph loads
